A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same G-NLL research work. All 25 pages of each version, including equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–D, are available and readable, supporting a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original synthetic simulations and question-answering evaluations, including estimator comparisons and ablations in Sections 3 and 5 and Appendices C–D.

after.justification: v3 retains those original simulation, question-answering and ablation results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: G-NLL still sums negative token log-probabilities along one greedily decoded sequence. Its definition in v2 Eq. (10) matches v3 Eq. (9). The scoring-rule revisions change its theoretical justification, not the implemented procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate short-phrase and full-sentence answers on TriviaQA, SVAMP and NQ-Open. The synthetic scenarios with vocabulary sizes 20 and 100 and sequence lengths 2–4 are also retained.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain PE, LN-PE, SE, LN-SE and D-SE. The ablations also retain the same length-normalized G-NLL, multinomial-sampling and beam-search alternatives.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendices C–D retain the model configurations, dataset sizes, generation procedures and evaluation protocols. These include ten samples for entropy baselines, the same temperature search, correctness judgments, AUROC and rejection accuracy on the 80% most certain predictions.

E4.justification: The synthetic approximation analyses, decoding ablation in Figure 2, length-normalization comparison in Table 4 and beam-search evaluation in Table 5 are unchanged. No additional robustness tests or case studies appear.

E5.justification: Both retain the 2,000-distribution simulation in Figure 1, 2,000 runs in Appendix C, standard-deviation and quantile summaries, and Table 1 standard errors and p < 0.05 significance markers.

E6.justification: Tables 1–5 and Figures 1–5 retain their numerical and plotted results. For example, Table 1's overall AUROC remains 0.721 ± 0.003 for G-NLL and 0.707 ± 0.003 for D-SE. No result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: Section 2.3 replaces v2's probability-weighted modal indicator with one minus the modal indicator in v3 Eq. (6), substantially revising the central scoring-rule foundation. Appendix A.2 similarly revises the cluster score and corrects swapped modal-sequence expectations. Appendix A.1 removes a misplaced posterior expectation but introduces an incorrect ratio-of-logarithms equality in the KL derivation. The final uncertainty decompositions and Theorem 1 remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the claims of a principled MSP justification, efficient approximation through G-NLL, and competitive or superior performance relative to more expensive multi-sequence measures.

C2.justification: The interpretations of sampling variability, decoding tradeoffs and length normalization are retained. The same limitations concerning semantics, token-probability access and efficient approximation of maximum cluster probability remain.

D1.justification: The reproducibility statement and Appendix D retain the code/data access information, implementation and hyperparameter disclosures, and resource estimates of eight A100 GPUs and roughly 100 node hours.

R1.justification: The bibliography and substantive positioning remain unchanged, including the relationship to earlier heuristic MSP baselines and entropy-based uncertainty methods. No cited work is added or removed.

P1.justification: Local rewrites in Section 2.1 and Appendix A explain the copied variables, explicitly state the loss convention and expand expectation notation. A displayed expression becomes inline, shifting equation numbering. The overall narrative and section structure remain intact.

P2.justification: Theoretical equations are reformatted and reflowed, with added/subtracted terms shaded in Appendix A. Some table rules and spacing change, notably in Tables 1 and 3–5. All figures and tables are retained without substantive display redesign.

improvement.justification: v3 fixes the probability factor and swapped modes in the central zero-one derivation and makes the expectation notation easier to follow. These changes improve mathematical consistency, but Appendix A.1 newly equates a difference of logarithms with a ratio of logarithms, leaving an explicit derivation error. The net gain is limited; the method and empirical evidence are unchanged.
